user.title: Connect to a JellyFish controller
user.description: Give the controller a fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) so it can always be found.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the JellyFish controller on your network.
New IP address or hostname of the same JellyFish controller.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a JellyFish controller at that address. Check the IP, and close the JellyFish app on your phone if it's open (the controller only allows one connection at a time).

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different JellyFish controller.

apply_light_string.name: Apply light string
apply_light_string.description: Paint a repeating sequence of colors along one or more JellyFish zones.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: List of RGB colors, e.g. [[255, 0, 0], [255, 255, 255]]. The sequence repeats along the zone.

run_pattern.name: Run custom pattern
run_pattern.description: Build a pattern from colors and an effect, like the JellyFish app's editor. It isn't saved unless you use Save pattern.

pattern_type.name: Effect type
pattern_type.description: How the colors move: Color (static), Chase, Paint, Stacker, Sequence or Multi-Paint.

spacing.name: Spacing
spacing.description: Space between color blocks (the app's 'space between pixels').

effect_between.name: Blend
effect_between.description: How colors blend into each other.

adjust_pattern.name: Adjust running pattern
adjust_pattern.description: Change parts of what's playing now (speed, effect, colors, ...) and keep the rest.

pattern_type.name: Effect type
pattern_type.description: How the colors move: Color (static), Chase, Paint, Stacker, Sequence or Multi-Paint.

spacing.name: Spacing
spacing.description: Space between color blocks (the app's 'space between pixels').

effect_between.name: Blend
effect_between.description: How colors blend into each other.

save_pattern.name: Save pattern
save_pattern.description: Save what's playing now as a named pattern on the controller, so it shows up by name in Home Assistant and the JellyFish app.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Folder to save it in (default: Home Assistant).

delete_pattern.name: Delete pattern
delete_pattern.description: Delete a saved pattern from the controller. Built-in (factory) patterns can't be deleted.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Pattern to delete, as Folder/Name (for example Custom/Purple + Orange).
